p.title: v59.97 a saved conversation turn without an answer or an unreadable store no longer breaks or erases saved conversations
p.symptom: One stored turn without a string answer made every later save throw inside the end-of-answer handler (no more saved turns, no follow-up chips, the run held until its timeout); a stored value that did not parse was silently replaced by a store holding only the newest conversation.
p.root_cause: loadSessions kept turns as stored and turnChars read t.q.length + t.a.length, so a missing field threw during pruning; a parse failure fell back to an empty list that the next save wrote over the reader's unreadable data.
p.fix: readSessionStore (src/ai/session/chat-sessions.js) normalises each kept turn (non-objects dropped; q, a, ctx coerced to strings; at kept) and reports whether the store was readable; saveSessions refuses to write (saved: false) over a stored value that is not a readable list, and turnChars coerces its fields. loadSessions keeps its shape.
p.violated_rule: Stored conversations are the reader's data and are never lost on a parse error.
p.prevention: ci-ai-intelligence-contract-check: a stored turn { q, at } without a saves the next turn with a: ''; a truncated JSON store returns saved: false from appendTurn and deleteSession and stays byte-identical, and loadSessions returns [].
p.verification: node scripts/ci-ai-intelligence-contract-check.mjs passes; the three v59.97 checks fail on the old module.

changelog: **Saved AI conversations survive bad data ({P}):** a stored turn without an answer no longer stops later saves, and a store that cannot be read is left in place instead of being overwritten.
note: v59.97: chat sessions tolerate a bad turn and never overwrite an unreadable store
